decisions.reason: As a core semi-hard cheese that remained prominently listed after launch, it likely fits the firm's main assortment and is worth retaining unless sales clearly deteriorate.
The spicy cheese appears to be a differentiated flavor variant with somewhat narrower demand than the core range, but its continued standalone presentation supports keeping it for now.
The mild creamy soft cheese was presented as rounding out the new offering and should have relatively broad mass-market appeal, making discontinuation less likely in the next year.
